features.feature: Harness-owned acceptance wrapper: verify acceptance-script content hash equals frozen expected hash, run from harness-owned path (not agent-editable workspace), return {acceptancePass, scriptHash, hashOk}
Anti-gaming: acceptance script NOT visible in agent editable workspace (§2 anti-gaming constraint)
Hash-check enforces frozen independently-authored acceptance script (hash verified BEFORE execution)
Hidden-regression check: hiddenRegressionPass = no NEW failing tests vs frozen baseline snapshot (post-state minus baseline), return {hiddenRegressionPass, newFailures}
Diff-hygiene check: diffHygienePass = change confined to allowed paths with no junk/forbidden artifacts, return {diffHygienePass, violations}
Exact §7 field names: acceptancePass, hiddenRegressionPass, diffHygienePass (schema contract for run-record and analysis)
Offline selfcheck (checks-selfcheck.mjs): covers pass+fail cases for each check, section-7 field name assertions, node --check both files, zero live LLM
Runner wiring / run driver / analysis script / powered run (not this story)
